title: Finish the other half
_map: Mirror world (Y2). Big idea: lines of symmetry. Creative: design a symmetrical house or butterfly; Steve builds half wrong for him to fix.
_story: Steve builds a house in blocks, but only one half. A mirror line shows how the other half must look. Then Steve builds a whole house with a mistake for Ismaeel to spot.
_stepChain: a mirror (disco: reflect) shows a flipped copy → fold line: both halves match → that line is called a line of symmetry → complete the other half → spot Steve's mistake → design your own

talk.goodAnswer: both halves match exactly, like a reflection in a mirror along the line.

talk.ask: How did you spot Steve's mistake?
talk.goodAnswer: one window wasn't in the matching place on the other side of the line.

handsOn: Fold a piece of paper in half, paint blobs on one side, then fold and press. Open it up: a symmetrical butterfly! Or build a symmetrical house from Lego.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Oops! I started building a house, but I only finished one half! I want both sides to match perfectly.

Imagine a mirror, standing right down the middle. Every block on this side has a twin on the other side, the same distance from the mirror. A line where both halves match like that is called a line of symmetry.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Now I built a whole house, all by myself. It's perfectly symmetrical! I think.

question.onRight: Yes, you spotted it! The window on the right is one block too far out!

0.mistake: looked at the whole shape but didn't compare each pair of twins
0.hint: Look at the windows. Is each one the same distance from the middle?
0.say: Look at the windows. The left one is one block from the edge. The right one is right at the edge! They don't match. So it isn't symmetrical.

question.reveal: Move the window one block in, and both sides match!

narration.text: Symmetry is everywhere! A butterfly's wings. A leaf. Your face! Even a Minecraft creeper's face! Look around. Can you find something symmetrical?
Now design your own symmetrical house, or a butterfly! Build one half. Then copy each block to the other side, the same distance from the line.

rule.text: Symmetrical: both halves match across the line.
rule.ask: What's a line of symmetry? Say it out loud! Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A line of symmetry splits a shape into two halves that match exactly, like a reflection in a mirror.

bonus.prompt: Bonus! How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
bonus.reveal: 4! Up and down, side to side, and corner to corner both ways.
